confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Bodrum's July resort pricing; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July is peak season and prices vary widely by location and property. Turkish lira volatility adds uncertainty to all USD figures. Cocktail and wine were estimated from the local beer anchor: a cocktail at about 2.2x beer and a glass of wine at about 1.4x beer, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a Mediterranean/Aegean summer resort town, benchmarked against comparable coastal resorts in southern Europe and Turkey's Aegean and Mediterranean coast (e.g., Marmaris, Fethiye, Kusadasi). Turkey is classed as Europe for this schema because Bodrum is an Aegean resort whose tourist pricing resembles southern European coastal towns.
